research.title: Concord acquires UK-based indie label Ninja Tune
research.summary: Concord acquires prominent London-based independent label Ninja Tune, expanding its presence in the UK and Europe. The deal brings Ninja Tune's recorded music operations and publishing arm Just Isn't Music under Concord's umbrella. Founded in 1990 by Coldcut, Ninja Tune's catalog includes The Prodigy, Soulwax, Bonobo, ODESZA, Flying Lotus and many more. The label will continue operating under current leadership.

research.title: Spotify to let users edit the algorithm behind their personalized recommendations with 'Taste Profile'
research.summary: Spotify announces 'Taste Profile' - a new feature letting users see and shape the listening data driving their personalized recommendations. Initially available in beta for Premium users in New Zealand. Users can flag if the profile doesn't reflect their preferences and ask for more or less of something, or describe their current mood. Extends beyond listening data to include context like training or commuting habits.

research.title: Nvidia unveils AI audio generator Fugatto that can produce 'sounds never heard before'
